v1.5 — 3C MASTER + SPEED (aap ki request: "1 trade per sec"): Engine ab 10 second scan karta hai (pehle 30s), aur sab se bada upgrade — LIVE candle par instant stop-order trigger: breakout candle ke CLOSE ka intezaar khatam — chalti hui candle trigger price cross karti HI entry (bilkul real trader ke stop order jaisa, ab tak 5 minute tak late hota tha). Jitne symbols par ek saath setup fire hoga utne trades foran khulenge (unlimited). 3C rules same: C1+C2 body ≥ 70%, C3 protected close, 5-candle window, close-based invalidation, SL opposite extreme, TP +3R. v1.4 base: Daily P/L UNLIMITED · risk % aap ka (default 1%) · AI har 6h nayi strategy (auto-evolve) · Strategy Lab (text/YouTube) · permanent Year→Month→Day history · paper $100 default · 24/7 watchdog.
